reasoning: Extensive empirical research, including a peer-reviewed study evaluating GPT-4 on the Uniform Bar Examination (UBE), established that modern large language models can pass the US bar exam with scores exceeding the average human test-taker. Specifically, the study published by researchers at Chicago-Kent College of Law and Stanford showed that GPT-4 passed all components of the exam and scored significantly above the passing threshold, outperforming the average human test-taker on the Multistate Bar Examination (MBE) by roughly 7% or more. Subsequent benchmark tests with newer LLMs have consistently replicated and exceeded these results.
title: AI systems now pass the bar exam
